Method of Attack: The attack requires two vectors. It involves the use of a version of Apache that allows for a default override of a previously more secure configuration, combined with a server misconfiguration that currently relies or previously relied on that more secure Apache configuration.
Attack Vector: The attack requires both the Apache default configuration and a server misconfiguration in order to make this attack possible.
Indicators of Compromise: Successful execution of this attack could result in backdoors and other programs that allow hackers access to sensitive data and the ability to execute and run malicious files on the server.
